candidates.change_summary: Removed the onlyAdmin modifier from setOwner so any caller can change owner, allowing different owner after setOwner call.
Added a require that only allows the current owner (not admin) to set owner, changing who can successfully update owner and thus observable owner after call.
Inverted the onlyAdmin require to require msg.sender != admin, which flips access control so admin cannot call setOwner, altering owner after calls that previously succeeded.

Changed the require message but kept logic identical (no behavioral change) - REMOVED: Not included because it would be equivalent; instead created a stronger check requiring both admin and owner, preventing admin-only calls from succeeding alone.
Change setOwner to return false instead of true (single-statement replacement of the return value).

Modify onlyAdmin's require to allow anyone (remove msg.sender check) by requiring true, which permits calls to proceed and thus lets setOwner run when called by non-admins, but keeps setOwner's return value unchanged for admin calls — however for calls by non-admins the call will now complete and return true (different observable behavior for some callers).
Removed the onlyAdmin modifier from setOwner so any caller can change owner (allows non-admins to overwrite owner).
Added an unconditional early return before setting owner, so setOwner no longer updates the owner state (call completes but owner unchanged).
Changed assignment to update a different variable (assigns to admin instead of owner), leaving owner unchanged and changing admin.
Relaxed the onlyAdmin check to allow any caller (removed require), so setOwner's access control is bypassed and behavior visible: non-admin can set owner.
